claims.claim: Guided original-sample curves coincide across all three seeds on every panel; seed means are descriptive, not independent data replications.

Guided budget-averaged disruption exceeds each comparator on every panel. At the smallest NBA 2014 budget, guidance ties the small-margin control; the other plotted seed-averaged cells favor guidance. This does not imply universally positive paired uncertainty.

All Arena paired intervals are strictly positive; all degree-stratified NBA intervals include zero. NBA 2012 small-margin comparisons are positive for all seeds; NBA 2011 small-margin and NBA 2012 uniform each have one wholly positive interval. NBA 2013–2015 intervals all include zero.
Arena finite-shift discrepancy spans 0.2235–0.3350; NBA spans about 0.00036–0.02274. This is a normalized coefficient-shift diagnostic, not rank error, superiority, or an accuracy threshold.

claims.claim: Recorded CPU evaluation durations span approximately 29.6–30.5 seconds per seed evaluation, not method-only timings or speedup measurements.

The fixed estimator uses sum logistic loss with unit quadratic ridge, centered participant scores, fractional uneditable ties, and a regularized optional NBA home effect. Nominal fractions .001, .005, .01 use all rows and floor-rounded nested binary flips.

claims.claim: Influence screening uses genuine Hessian derivatives, a frozen top-min(10,p) adjacent contrast, width-two exact-refitted path selection, and up to six nearby contrast proposals. The lexicographic internal objective leads with summed displacement, not the reported inversion fraction.
claims.support_scope: Registered final evidence identifies the evaluated condition; readable documentation, not hashes or metric values, supports implementation specifics.

claims.claim: The available source implements strict complete-path swaps/replacements with sorted original-row prefix caching and incumbent fallback. It uses up to 24 sampled positions, additional refit caps 72 or 24 by dimension, a two-second optional deadline, and 128 proposals; no execution trace establishes accepted exchange counts or isolated exchange benefit.
